about.heading: A small workshop, run by the people who do the work
about.body:
Corve Dale Joinery started in 1998 in a converted cattle shed outside Ludlow. Today it is still three of us: we take the call, visit your home, make the piece and fit it.

We use British oak and sustainably sourced softwoods, and we're happy to match old mouldings when you're restoring a period property.
